caption:
Momo can kick past her head, yet her landings wobble. Many dancers have plenty of flexibility but less strength at end range.

Clinical Pilates trains control through the full range, which can help extensions, balances and landings feel steadier. Side-lying work and reformer footwork help more of your turnout come from the hips, and slow single-leg rises build feet and calves for long rehearsal days. One or two sessions a week is a good start, lighter in performance weeks.

Pain in one spot on the foot or shin that builds with jumping is worth an assessment. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment, then builds a program around your dance style. Book online via the link in bio 🩰
